_comment: Tokens with no Figma variable behind them, emitted into theme.css by build-theme.mjs. Each needs a note saying why Figma can't hold it. Keep this list short — anything Figma *can* bind belongs in Figma, not here.

focus-ring-offset.note: Measured off the Button focus-ring layer in Figma (46:41). Can't be variable-bound because the Plugin API's VariableBindableNodeField doesn't include x/y position. Fixed across theme and density: a focus ring's offset is an a11y distance, not compressible spacing.
